name: ITC Hotels Ltd
about: ITC Hotels is an Indian hospitality company that operates and manages hotels, with over 200 hotels. It has a franchise agreement to operate most of its hotels as part of The Luxury Collection of Marriott International. It operates hotels across 90+ destinations under brands like ITC Hotels, Mementos, Epiq Collection Storii, Welcomhotel, Fortune, and Welcome Heritage.[1][2]
keyPoints: Demerger:[1] ITC Hotels became a separate company following the demerger of ITC Limited's hotel business, effective 1st January 2025 and listed on 29th January 2025. ITC retained 40% equity, with the remaining 60% allotted to ITC shareholders in proportion to their holdings.
cons: Stock is trading at 3.27 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of 6.65% over last 3 years.
